posts.title: Fun with e-paper
posts.description: I have quite a few of the very nice Waveshare 7.5" mono e-paper panels with laminated black bordered glass front. So I have decided to make a new fun project - a battery based sign. The project involves a small PCB, and a carefully designed 3D printed case.
